description: Land Acquisition - FVP No. 563 and 562 of Habarathtawala, Sooriyawewa D/S Division, Hambantota District - Amendments to the Notices published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1964/7 of 25.04.2016 by Sooriyawewa D/S Division and No. 1868/4 of 23.07.2014 by R.D.A.
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land lots for public purposes, including descriptions of each parcel, extents, and claimant information. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and it doesn't fit any other specialized categories.
